info.title: AnvilID Management API
info.description: Installation-level management of tenants, OAuth clients, users, sessions, the audit log and tenant email settings. Requests carry a Bearer access token issued by the system tenant. Lists use cursor pagination (`after`, `limit`); errors are RFC 9457 problem details.

get.summary: List tenants.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return items after this id (the previous page's `next_cursor`).

post.summary: Create a tenant (with its first signing key).

409.description: Slug or host already in use

get.summary: Get a tenant.

delete.summary: Delete a tenant with all its data. `system` and `default` cannot be deleted (403).

403.description: Insufficient scope, or a protected tenant

patch.summary:
Update a tenant (the slug is immutable). Settings are merged with the current ones; the
CAPTCHA secret is write-only. Turning on `email_otp` or `magic_link` needs SMTP (the tenant's
SMTP settings or the installation SMTP). Enabling a signing algorithm creates its key at once; disabling
one that a client still uses for its ID tokens is refused (409, the problem lists the
clients). `dcr` and `cimd` are merged field by field; the system tenant refuses any policy
but `disabled` (422).

409.description: Host already in use, or a disabled signing algorithm is still used by clients

get.summary: List the attribute definitions of a tenant.

200.description: Every definition, by position then name

get.summary: Get an attribute definition.

put.summary:
Create or replace an attribute definition. Stored user values are never rewritten: a value
that no longer validates is omitted from tokens until it is corrected.

422.description: Invalid name, schema or claim rule (the field error names it)

delete.summary:
Delete an attribute definition. Users' stored values are kept (a re-created definition sees
them again) but no longer reach tokens.

get.summary: Query the audit log of a tenant.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on the event time (RFC 3339).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on the event time (RFC 3339).

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Actor id (user id, client id or admin subject).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Target (user id, client id, session id, ...).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Return events older than this event id (the previous page's `next_cursor`).

200.description: One page of events, newest first

get.summary: Get the tenant's branding (`customized: false` when it inherits).

put.summary: Set the tenant's theme tokens and custom CSS (the logo is kept). Contrast below 4.5:1 is returned as warnings, below 3:1 refused.

200.description: The stored branding with contrast warnings

delete.summary: Remove the tenant's branding (back to the inherited theme).

put.summary: Set the tenant's logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 256 KiB, standard base64; SVG is refused).

200.description: The branding with the new logo

delete.summary: Remove the tenant's logo.

post.summary: Store a tenant's preview draft and get a 15-minute preview URL (same origin, `/t/{slug}/ui/preview?token=…`).
Publish a tenant's preview draft (identified by its preview token) as the live branding.

404.description: Unknown tenant (or unknown, expired or other-scope preview token)

get.summary:
List the clients of a tenant: static, dynamically registered and CIMD clients
(`registration_source`).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return items after this id (the previous page's `next_cursor`).

post.summary: Register a client. Secret-based clients get their `client_secret` in this response only.

201.description: Created; includes client_secret for secret-based clients

get.summary: Get a client (never includes the secret).

delete.summary:
Delete a client and revoke its tokens. A deleted CIMD client (URL client id, percent-encoded
in the path) is fetched again on its next use if the tenant's CIMD policy still allows its
host; block a host with the `allow_listed` CIMD policy instead.

patch.summary:
Update a client. The merged registration (including the ID-token algorithm against the
tenant's enabled algorithms) is validated again.

get.summary: Get the client's branding (`customized: false` when it inherits).

put.summary: Set the client's theme tokens and custom CSS (the logo is kept). Contrast below 4.5:1 is returned as warnings, below 3:1 refused.

200.description: The stored branding with contrast warnings

delete.summary: Remove the client's branding (back to the inherited theme).

404.description: Unknown tenant or client (or no branding)

put.summary: Set the client's logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 256 KiB, standard base64; SVG is refused).

200.description: The branding with the new logo

delete.summary: Remove the client's logo.

404.description: Unknown tenant or client (or no logo)

post.summary: Store a client's preview draft and get a 15-minute preview URL (same origin, `/t/{slug}/ui/preview?token=…`).
Publish a client's preview draft (identified by its preview token) as the live branding.

404.description: Unknown tenant or client (or unknown, expired or other-scope preview token)

post.summary: Rotate the client secret. The new secret is returned once; the old one stops working.

422.description: The client does not use a secret

get.summary: Export a tenant's configuration as a `TenantConfig` document.

200.description: The tenant's document: static clients, connections, branding, roles, attributes, email templates, SMTP and webhooks by natural key; secrets as {configured: bool}

post.summary:
Apply a document: validate everything first, then write through the services. Re-applying
an applied document changes nothing.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Tenant slug (must equal tenant.slug of the document; a missing tenant is created)

parameters.name: prune
parameters.description: Also delete the objects the document no longer lists (default false).

200.description: Applied (or nothing to do); generated secrets are shown once

403.description: Insufficient scope, or role changes beyond the caller's admin scopes

409.description: The document would remove the last administrator of the system tenant, or a name is taken

422.description: Invalid document (errors list every issue by path); nothing was changed

post.summary: Validate a document and show the plan against the stored state (nothing is changed).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Tenant slug (must equal tenant.slug of the document)

200.description: The plan; deletes are applied only with prune

403.description: Insufficient scope, or role changes beyond the caller's admin scopes

409.description: The document would remove the last administrator of the system tenant

422.description: Invalid document (errors list every issue by path)

get.summary: List the upstream connections of a tenant.

200.description: Every connection of the tenant, in slug order

post.summary:
Create an upstream connection. The secret (Apple: the `.p8` key PEM) is sealed and never
returned.

409.description: Slug already in use in this tenant

get.summary: Get an upstream connection (never includes the secret).

delete.summary: Delete an upstream connection and every identity link made through it.

patch.summary:
Update an upstream connection. Absent fields stay unchanged; the slug is immutable and a new
`config` must keep the kind. Trusting Microsoft-asserted email needs
`accept_email_trust_risk`.

put.summary:
Set or remove the client secret of a connection (Apple: the `.p8` private key PEM, which
must be an ES256 PKCS#8 key). Write-only: the response reports `secret_configured`.

get.summary: List every email template of a tenant (overrides and defaults).
Get one email template: the tenant override, or the theme default (`customized: false`).

put.summary:
Save a tenant override of an email template. The template is compiled, checked for
unknown variables and test-rendered first.

422.description: Invalid template (errors carry field and line)

delete.summary: Remove the tenant override (back to the theme default). Idempotent.

get.summary: List the initial access tokens of a tenant (values are never returned).

200.description: Every token of the tenant, including revoked and expired ones

post.summary:
Issue an initial access token. The value is returned once. Tokens can be issued under any
registration policy (to prepare a switch to `allow_listed`), never for the system tenant.

201.description: Issued; `value` is shown only in this response

422.description: Invalid description, lifetime or use count, or the system tenant

delete.summary: Revoke an initial access token. Clients it already registered are not affected.

404.description: Unknown tenant or token, or already revoked

get.summary: List the signing keys of a tenant (never any private key material).

200.description: Every signing key of the tenant, newest first

post.summary:
Rotate a signing key of a tenant. Without `immediate`, a next key is published now and the
scheduled job activates it after the prepublish period (an existing next key is kept). With
`immediate` (key compromise), a new key signs at once and the old one leaves the JWKS, so
tokens it signed stop verifying.

200.description: The kid of the key that signs next

409.description: The active key changed during rotation; retry

422.description: The algorithm is not enabled for the tenant

get.summary: List the organizations of a tenant.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return items after this id (the previous page's `next_cursor`).

200.description: One page of organizations, in id order

post.summary: Create an organization. Not available in the system tenant (422).

409.description: An organization with this slug already exists

422.description: Validation failed, or the tenant is the system tenant

get.summary: Get an organization (by id or slug). Also allowed for the org's own admin.

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

delete.summary:
Delete an organization with its memberships, org roles, assignments, connections, domains and
invitations; its token families are revoked (tenant administrators only).

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token
Insufficient scope, or an org admin token

404.description: Unknown tenant, organization or default role

409.description: Slug already in use

get.summary: List the organization's invitations, newest first (never the token or its hash).

parameters.name: include_closed
parameters.description: Also list accepted and revoked invitations (default `false`: open and expired ones).

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

post.summary:
Invite an address to the organization: stores only the SHA-256 of a 256-bit token, expires
after 7 days and enqueues the `org_invitation` email with the link. The answer is the same
whether or not an account exists for the address.

201.description: Invitation created and its email queued

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

404.description: Unknown tenant, organization or role (or a role of another organization)

422.description: Validation failed, or a role carries admin permissions

delete.summary: Revoke an open invitation.

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

404.description: Unknown tenant or organization, or no open invitation with this id

get.summary: List the members of an organization.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return items after this id (the previous page's `next_cursor`).

200.description: One page of members, in user id order

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

post.summary:
Add a user of the tenant to the organization directly, with roles assigned in the org
(idempotent: an existing member is kept unchanged, 200). Tenant administrators only: org
admins invite members instead.

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token

404.description: Unknown tenant, organization, user or role (or a role of another organization)

422.description: Validation failed, or a role carries admin permissions

delete.summary:
Remove a member: their org role assignments go with the membership and their token families
bound to this org are revoked, in one storage intent. An org admin may not remove the last
org admin (409); a tenant administrator may.

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

404.description: Unknown tenant or organization, or the user is not a member

409.description: The organization would have no org admin

get.summary: List the roles a member holds in the organization (org-owned and tenant roles).

200.description: The member's roles in the org, in name order

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

404.description: Unknown tenant or organization, or the user is not a member

put.summary:
Assign a role to a member within the organization (idempotent). The role is an org-owned role
of this org or a tenant role; a role carrying an admin permission is refused (422).

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `org` or `tenant`; absent = the org-owned role, else the tenant role of that name.

200.description: The member holds the role in the org

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

404.description: Unknown tenant, organization or role, or the user is not a member

422.description: The role carries admin permissions, or invalid query

delete.summary:
Remove a role from a member within the organization. An org admin may not remove the last org
admin's `org:admin` (409); a tenant administrator may.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `org` or `tenant`; absent = the org-owned role, else the tenant role of that name.

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

404.description: Unknown tenant, organization or role, or the member does not hold it

409.description: The organization would have no org admin

get.summary: List the roles owned by the organization.

200.description: The org-owned roles, in name order

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

post.summary:
Create an org-owned role. Admin permissions (`admin`, `admin:*`) are refused (422);
`org:admin` makes holders org admins.

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

409.description: A role with this name already exists in the organization

422.description: Validation failed, or an admin permission

get.summary: Get an org-owned role.

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

delete.summary:
Delete an org-owned role and its assignments. An org admin may not delete an `org:admin` role
when that leaves the org without an org admin (409).

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

409.description: The organization would have no org admin

patch.summary:
Update an org-owned role. An org admin may not drop `org:admin` when that leaves the org
without an org admin (409).

403.description: Insufficient scope, or an org admin token of another organization

409.description: Name already in use, or the organization would have no org admin

422.description: Validation failed, or an admin permission

get.summary: List the roles of a tenant.

200.description: Every role of the tenant, in name order

post.summary: Create a role. In the system tenant this needs `admin:write`.

403.description: Insufficient scope, or the role carries admin scopes the caller lacks

409.description: A role with this name already exists

get.summary: Get a role.

delete.summary:
Delete a role and its assignments. In the system tenant this needs `admin:write`, and
deleting an `admin:write` role must leave another active administrator (409 otherwise).

409.description: The deletion would remove the last administrator

patch.summary:
Update a role. In the system tenant this needs `admin:write`, and removing `admin:write` from
the role must leave another active administrator (409 otherwise).

403.description: Insufficient scope, or the role carries admin scopes the caller lacks

409.description: Name already in use, or the change would remove the last administrator

get.summary: List the users holding a role.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return items after this id (the previous page's `next_cursor`).

200.description: One page of users holding the role

get.summary: List the active sessions of a tenant.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return items after this id (the previous page's `next_cursor`).

delete.summary: Revoke one session (and the tokens issued under it).

404.description: Unknown tenant, or no such active session

get.summary:
Get the tenant's SMTP settings (never the password). 404 when the tenant uses the
installation SMTP server.

404.description: Unknown tenant, or no tenant SMTP settings

put.summary: Set the tenant's SMTP settings. An absent or empty password keeps the stored one.

delete.summary: Remove the tenant's SMTP settings (back to the installation SMTP server). Idempotent.

post.summary:
Send a test email with the stored SMTP settings (synchronous, bounded by a 10 s timeout).
An SMTP failure is reported in the body (`delivered: false`), not as an error status.

422.description: Invalid recipient, or no tenant SMTP settings

get.summary: List the users of a tenant.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return items after this id (the previous page's `next_cursor`).

post.summary: Create a user with a password, or invite them by email.

409.description: Email or username already in use

get.summary: Get a user.

delete.summary: Delete a user with their credentials and sessions, and revoke their tokens.

409.description: The user is the system tenant's last administrator

patch.summary: Update a user (email, verification flag, username, claims, status).

409.description: Email or username already in use, or blocking the system tenant's last administrator

get.summary: Get a user's attribute values.

put.summary:
Replace a user's attribute values. Every value is validated against its definition; a refusal
changes nothing and lists each failing JSON pointer.

422.description: Invalid values: `errors` lists each failing JSON pointer (`/department`); nothing was stored

get.summary: List a user's credentials (password, passkeys, TOTP). No secret material is returned.

delete.summary:
Remove a passkey or the TOTP factor (with its recovery codes) of a user. Passwords cannot
be removed here.

404.description: Unknown tenant, user or credential (or a password)

get.summary: List the roles of a user.

200.description: The user's roles, in name order

put.summary:
Assign a role to a user (idempotent). In the system tenant the caller's token must hold
every admin scope the role carries.

403.description: Insufficient scope, or the role carries admin scopes the caller lacks

delete.summary:
Remove a role from a user. In the system tenant the caller's token must hold every admin
scope the role carries, and removing the last active administrator is refused (409).

403.description: Insufficient scope, or the role carries admin scopes the caller lacks

404.description: Unknown tenant or role, or the user does not hold it

409.description: The change would remove the last administrator

get.summary: List a user's active sessions, newest first.

delete.summary: Revoke every session of a user (and the tokens issued under them).

get.summary: List the webhook endpoints of a tenant.

post.summary: Create a webhook endpoint. The response carries the signing secret once.

201.description: Created; `secret` is shown only in this response

409.description: An endpoint with this name already exists

422.description: Invalid name, events, or a URL refused by the outbound policy

post.summary:
Queue a delivery's event again (new delivery id, fresh attempts). The original delivery is
unchanged.

get.summary: Get a webhook endpoint (without its secret).

delete.summary: Delete a webhook endpoint and its delivery log.

patch.summary: Update a webhook endpoint. Re-enabling clears the system's disabled reason.

409.description: Name already in use

422.description: Invalid name, events, or a URL refused by the outbound policy

get.summary: The delivery log of an endpoint, newest first.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return items after this id (the previous page's `next_cursor`).

200.description: One page of deliveries, newest first

post.summary:
Rotate the signing secret. The new secret is returned once; the previous one keeps signing
(as a second signature) for 24 hours.

200.description: The new secret, shown only in this response

post.summary: Queue the `test` event for the endpoint, whatever its subscriptions.

202.description: Queued; follow it in the delivery log

role_ids.description:
Roles assigned in the org with the membership: ids of tenant roles or of roles owned by
this org, none carrying an admin permission.

AppleConfig.description:
Sign in with Apple: the team and key the `.p8` private key (the connection secret) belongs
to.

oneOf.description:
How the value is mapped into tokens; `null` = not emitted. A value is emitted only while
it validates against the current schema.

name.description: Unique in the tenant: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$`, not a protocol or standard claim name.

required.description: Every user must have a value (checked when a user's values are written).

schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) every value must satisfy.

user_editable.description: The user may edit the value on the account page.

AttributeDefinitionList.description: Attribute definitions, by position then name.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next (older) page; present if and only if more items follow.

details.description: Typed details (identifiers, enum names, counts; never secrets).

expires_at.description: RFC 3339; the token stops working after this (15 minutes).

preview_url.description:
Same-origin path of the preview page: `/t/{slug}/ui/preview?token=…`. Only this page
may be framed, and only by the same origin.

token.description: The preview token (also needed to publish this draft).

client_id.description: The client of a client scope.

customized.description: `false` when the scope has no branding of its own (it inherits; tokens are empty).

logo_url.description: Same-origin path of the scope's own logo (`/t/{slug}/theme/logo/{sha256}`), if any.

warnings.description: Contrast warnings of the stored tokens.

CaptchaInput.description:
CAPTCHA configuration as written by an administrator. The secret is sealed before it is
stored and is never returned.

CaptchaView.description: A tenant's CAPTCHA configuration (the secret is write-only).

configured.description: Always `true`: a secret is stored (sealed); it cannot be read back.

CimdPolicy.description:
Client ID Metadata Document policy: `disabled` (URL client ids are unknown clients),
`allow_listed` (documents on `allowed_hosts` only) or `open` (any https host passing the
outbound policy).

allowed_hosts.description:
Hosts whose documents are accepted under `allow_listed` (at least one); host names or IP
literals, no port.

min_cache_secs.description:
A document's `Cache-Control: max-age` is clamped to `min_cache_secs..=max_cache_secs`
(60 to 604800 seconds; default 300 and 86400).

policy.description:
Default `disabled`; `system` is always `disabled`. Blocking a document URL is done with
`allow_listed` (only the listed hosts are fetched).

CimdSettingsPatch.description:
Partial CIMD settings update: absent fields keep their current value; `allowed_hosts`
replaces the whole list.

ClaimMapping.description: JSON pointers (RFC 6901, e.g. `/id`) into a generic OAuth2 profile response.

next_cursor.description: Present if and only if more items follow.

ClientSecretView.description:
The new secret returned by `POST …/clients/{client_id}/secret`. The previous secret stops
working immediately.

ClientSource.description:
How a client came to exist: `static` (administrator), `dynamic` (RFC 7591 registration)
or `cimd` (materialised from a Client ID Metadata Document; the client id is its URL).

ClientView.description:
A registered OAuth client. `client_secret` is only present in the response that created the
client; it is never stored in plaintext and cannot be read again.

allowed_resources.description: Resource indicators (RFC 8707) the client may request.

can_introspect.description: May introspect any token of the tenant (confidential clients only).

client_secret.description: Returned once, on create (secret-based auth methods only).

id_token_signed_response_alg.description: ID-token signing algorithm (one of the tenant's `signing_algs`).

metadata_expires_at.description: CIMD clients: when the cached metadata document must be fetched again; `null` otherwise.

oneOf.description: Client MFA policy; `null` = the tenant's. The strictest of both wins.

organization.description: Organization policy (`organization` authorization parameter and org claims).

post_logout_redirect_uris.description: Where RP-initiated logout may redirect after signing out.

registration_source.description:
How the client came to exist. Dynamic and CIMD clients can be deleted like any client;
a deleted CIMD client is fetched again on its next use if the CIMD policy allows it.

generated_secrets.description:
Secrets the server generated (client secrets, webhook signing secrets); never readable
again.

plan.description: The plan that was applied (computed before the changes).

pruned.description: Whether the plan's deletes were performed.

ConfigChangeDto.description: One object to create, update or delete, by natural key.

key.description:
The natural key (`client_id`, slug, name, template kind, `(tenant)` for tenant-wide
branding, `smtp`).

ConfigFieldDiff.description: One changed field. Secret fields carry no values (`secret: true`).

ConfigPlanDto.description: The plan of a document against the stored state. `deletes` happen only with `prune`.

empty.description: Nothing to create, update or delete.

text.description: The plan as text (the CLI's rendering; secrets print as `(secret changed)`).

ConnectionConfig.description: Connection configuration, tagged by `type`. It never contains the client secret.

ConnectionKind.description: Kind of an upstream connection (derived from its config).

ConnectionList.description: Every connection of a tenant, in slug order.

ConnectionView.description:
An upstream connection. The client secret (Apple: the `.p8` key) is write-only:
`secret_configured` tells whether one is stored.

redirect_uri.description: The callback URL to register at the provider.

slug.description: Unique per tenant, immutable; part of `redirect_uri`.

trust_email_verified.description: Treat the provider's `email_verified` as proof of address ownership (auto-linking).

ConsentMode.description:
When the consent screen is shown: `required` asks for every scope not granted yet;
`skip_first_party` never asks (first-party clients only).

allowed_resources.description: Absolute URIs without fragment or query (RFC 8707).

oneOf.description: Default `none` for public clients, `client_secret_basic` for confidential clients.

backchannel_logout_uri.description: Absolute, no fragment; https (http only to loopback).

oneOf.description: Default `required`.

id_token_signed_response_alg.description: Default `RS256`; must be enabled in the tenant's `signing_algs`.

jwks.description: Inline public JWK Set, required for `private_key_jwt`.

jwks_uri.description: Not supported in this release (rejected with 422).

oneOf.description: Default `null` (the tenant's policy).
Default `off`. Must be `off` in the system tenant.

post_logout_redirect_uris.description: Redirect URI rules of the application type.

require_pkce.description: Default `true`. Only confidential clients may set `false`.

oneOf.description: Default `jwt`.

accept_email_trust_risk.description:
Required to trust email addresses asserted by Microsoft, which can be unverified
("nOAuth"). Default `false`.

secret.description: Client secret; Apple: the `.p8` private key PEM. Write-only.

slug.description: 1-63 characters of a-z, 0-9 and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

trust_email_verified.description: Default: `true` for Google, Apple and GitHub, `false` otherwise.

slug.description: 2-63 characters of a-z, 0-9 and '-'; `system` and `default` are reserved.

CreateUser.description:
Body of `POST /tenants/{slug}/users`. Set exactly one of `password` and `invite: true`; an
invitation emails a single-use link (valid 7 days) for the user to choose a password.

CredentialView.description:
A user credential (password, passkey or TOTP). Secrets, public keys and seeds are never
returned.

DcrPolicy.description:
Dynamic client registration policy: `disabled` (no `/register`), `allow_listed` (an
initial access token is required; optional redirect-host allow-list) or `open`.

allowed_redirect_hosts.description:
Redirect-URI hosts accepted under `allow_listed` (host names or IP literals, no port);
empty = any host allowed by the redirect URI rules.

allowed_resources.description: RFC 8707 resource indicators registered (and CIMD) clients may be granted.

allowed_scopes.description:
Scopes a registered client may request; empty = `openid profile email address phone`.
Admin API scopes are refused.

max_clients.description: Most dynamically registered clients the tenant may hold (default 1000; soft cap).

DcrSettingsPatch.description:
Partial DCR settings update: absent fields keep their current value; lists replace the
whole list.

EmailTemplateList.description: Every email template of a tenant.

EmailTemplateView.description: An email template: the tenant override (`customized: true`) or the theme default.

customized.description: Whether the tenant overrides the theme default.

updated_at.description: When the override was saved (`null` for the default).

EndpointOverrides.description:
Endpoint overrides of a social preset (`null` = the preset's value). Absolute https URLs
(plain http only to loopback hosts).

line.description: Line of the failing template part (email template validation only).

GeneratedSecretDto.description: A secret generated while applying, shown once.

InitialAccessTokenDto.description: An initial access token (never its value).

usable.description:
`true` while the token can still authorize a registration (not revoked, not expired,
uses left).

uses_remaining.description: Remaining uses; `null` = unlimited until expiry or revocation.

InitialAccessTokenList.description: Initial access tokens, in id (creation) order.

InvitationView.description: An invitation (never its token or token hash).

role_ids.description: Roles assigned in the org on acceptance.

IssuedInitialAccessToken.description: An issued token with its value: returned once, by `POST`.

value.description:
The bearer value for `POST /register` (`Authorization: Bearer …`). Shown once; only its
hash is stored.

KeyList.description: Every signing key of a tenant, newest first.

KeyState.description:
Lifecycle state of a signing key: `next` (published in the JWKS, not yet signing),
`active` (signs, one per algorithm) or `retired` (published until `expires_at`).

KeyView.description:
A signing key of a tenant: identification, lifecycle and timestamps only. The private key
(sealed or not) and the JWK are never part of this view; the public keys are served by the
tenant's `/jwks`.

activated_at.description: When the key started signing (absent while `next`).

expires_at.description: When a retired key leaves the JWKS.

added.description: `false` when the user already was a member (nothing changed, roles untouched).

MemberList.description: One page of members (user id order).

next_cursor.description: Present if and only if more items follow.

email.description: The user's email; `null` if the user no longer exists.

MfaPolicy.description:
Whether sign-in needs a second factor: `off`, `optional` (users who enrolled one) or
`required` (users without one enrol first). Across tenant and client the strictest wins.

description.description: At most 200 characters, no control characters.

expires_in.description: Lifetime in seconds, 60 to 31536000 (365 days); default 86400 (24 hours).

uses.description: Number of registrations it authorizes, 1 to 100000; `null` = unlimited until expiry.

role_ids.description:
Roles assigned in the org on acceptance: ids of tenant roles or of roles owned by this
org, none carrying an admin permission (at most 20).

name.description: Unique in the org: 1-64 characters of a-z, 0-9, '_', '.' or '-'.

permissions.description: At most 100 permissions; admin permissions (`admin`, `admin:*`) are refused.

oneOf.description: Default `null` (no org requirement).

slug.description: 2-63 characters of a-z, 0-9 and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

name.description: 1-64 characters of a-z, 0-9, '_', '.' or '-', starting with a letter or digit.

permissions.description: At most 100 permissions of 1-128 characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, ':', '.', '_', '/', '-').

NewTenantSettings.description:
Settings of a new tenant. Absent fields take their defaults; CAPTCHA is configured with
`PATCH` once the tenant exists.

claims.description: Default: `roles` gated by scope `roles`, `permissions` in the access token.

default_locale.description: Default `en`; a language tag such as `de` or `pt-BR`.

email_otp.description: Default `false`; needs SMTP (the installation's, for a new tenant).

magic_link.description: Default `false`; needs SMTP (the installation's, for a new tenant).

signing_algs.description: Signing algorithms to enable besides RS256 (`ES256`, `Ed25519`).

NewWebhookEndpoint.description: Body of `POST /tenants/{slug}/webhooks`. The secret is generated by the server.

events.description: At least one lifecycle event type (`test` is refused).

url.description:
`https` URL (plain `http` only in development mode); private, loopback and link-local
addresses are refused.

OAuth2ConnectionConfig.description: A generic OAuth2 provider (no ID token; identity from a profile endpoint).

OidcConnectionConfig.description: A generic OpenID Connect provider (discovery at `{issuer}/.well-known/openid-configuration`).

fetch_userinfo.description: Also call the UserInfo endpoint after the ID token was validated.

issuer.description: Absolute https URL (plain http only to loopback hosts).

OrgClientPolicy.description:
Organization policy of a client: `off` (no org claims; the `organization` authorization
parameter is refused), `optional` (an org is selected when the user belongs to one) or
`required` (every authorization needs an org).

OrgRolePatchDto.description: Body of `PATCH …/{org}/roles/{name}`. `permissions` replaces the whole set.

OrgRoleView.description: A role as seen from an organization.

permissions.description: Sorted, de-duplicated permission strings (`org:admin` makes the holder an org admin).

next_cursor.description: Present if and only if more items follow.

OrganizationPatchDto.description: Body of `PATCH …/organizations/{org}`. Absent fields stay unchanged.

default_role_ids.description:
Replaces the default roles: ids of tenant roles or of roles owned by this org, none
carrying an admin permission (at most 20).

oneOf.description: `null` removes the org's MFA requirement.

OrganizationView.description: An organization: a business customer inside a tenant.

default_role_ids.description: Roles given (in this org) to members created by just-in-time provisioning.

metadata.description: Free-form JSON object for the integrator.

oneOf.description:
The org's MFA policy; `null` = no org requirement. The strictest of tenant, org and
client wins.

slug.description: Unique in the tenant: 2-63 characters of a-z, 0-9 and '-'.

errors.description: Field errors (validation failures only; empty otherwise).

token.description: The preview token returned by the preview operation of the same scope.

PutAttributeDefinition.description: Body of `PUT /tenants/{slug}/attributes/{name}` (create or replace; the name is the path's).

oneOf.description:
Claim name, tokens and gating scope; the name must not collide with protocol, standard or
other mapped claims.

schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12): at most 16 KiB and depth 32, local `#/$defs` references only.

PutBranding.description: Tokens and custom CSS (live `PUT` and preview drafts).

custom_css.description:
Custom CSS (at most 32 KiB; no `@import`, `url(`, backslashes or other constructs outside
the allow-list). Absent, `null` or blank = none.

data.description:
The image bytes in standard base64 (RFC 4648 §4, padded): PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most
256 KiB decoded.

PutConnectionSecret.description:
Body of `PUT …/connections/{id}/secret`: a new secret, or `null` to remove it. The field is
required.

PutSmtpSettings.description: Body of `PUT …/smtp`. An absent or empty `password` keeps the stored one.

PutUserAttributes.description:
Body of `PUT /tenants/{slug}/users/{user_id}/attributes`: the complete set of defined values
(an absent defined attribute is removed; unknown keys are refused).

RegistrationMode.description: Who may self-register in a tenant.

RevokedSessions.description: Result of revoking all sessions of a user.

name.description: Unique in the tenant: 1-64 characters of a-z, 0-9, '_', '.' or '-'.

permissions.description:
Sorted, de-duplicated permission strings. In the system tenant, admin scopes here
(`admin:write`, `admin:users:read`, ...) are what the role's holders may obtain.

RolePatchDto.description:
Body of `PATCH /tenants/{slug}/roles/{name}`. Absent fields stay unchanged; `permissions`
replaces the whole set.

alg.description: The algorithm to rotate; it must be enabled for the tenant.

immediate.description:
`false` (default): publish a next key now; the scheduled job activates it after the
prepublish period. `true` (key compromise): activate a new key at once and drop the old
one from the JWKS, so tokens it signed stop verifying.

RotateKeyResponse.description: Result of a rotation: the kid of the key that signs next.

SessionList.description: A list of sessions (tenant lists are paged; a user's sessions come in one page).

next_cursor.description: Present if and only if more items follow.

SessionView.description: An active browser session. The session token is never returned.

idle_expires_at.description: Expiry if the session stays idle (refreshed by activity).

SigningAlg.description: A signing algorithm that a tenant key can use.

SmtpSettingsView.description: A tenant's SMTP settings. The password is never returned.

SmtpTestResult.description: Outcome of a test send. The call succeeds even when delivery fails.

error.description: The SMTP error (credentials redacted) when delivery failed.

SocialConnectionConfig.description: A social preset (Google, Apple, Microsoft, GitHub).

oneOf.description: Apple only (required there).

microsoft_tenant.description: Microsoft only: `common` (default), `organizations`, `consumers` or a tenant id.

scopes.description: Requested scopes; empty = the preset's defaults.

SocialProvider.description: Social provider preset of a connection.

StandardClaims.description: OIDC Core §5.1 standard claims other than `sub`, `email` and `email_verified`.

TenantConfigJson.description:
A `TenantConfig` document, version 1 (JSON form). The full schema is published as
`docs/schemas/tenant-config-v1.json`. Secrets: `{configured: bool}` keeps (true) or clears
(false) a stored secret, `{value: "…"}` sets it; exports always carry `{configured: …}`.

next_cursor.description: Present if and only if more items follow.

TenantSettings.description: Per-tenant settings as returned by the API. The CAPTCHA secret is never returned.

auto_link.description:
Link an upstream identity automatically when it asserts a trusted, verified email equal
to an existing account's verified email.

oneOf.description: CAPTCHA on registration and after repeated failed sign-ins; `null` = disabled.

cimd.description: Client ID Metadata Document policy in force (always `disabled` for `system`).

claims.description: Mapping of roles and permissions into tokens.

dcr.description: Dynamic client registration policy in force (always `disabled` for `system`).

default_locale.description: Page language when neither `ui_locales` nor `Accept-Language` matches.

email_otp.description: Sign-in with a one-time code sent by email.

magic_link.description: Sign-in with a magic link sent by email.

mfa_policy.description: Tenant MFA policy (a client may make it stricter).

require_verified_email.description: Users must verify their email address before they can sign in.

signing_algs.description: Enabled ID-token signing algorithms (`RS256`, `ES256`, `Ed25519`); RS256 is always first.

upstream_registration.description: Whether upstream sign-in may create accounts; `null` follows `registration`.

TenantSettingsPatch.description:
Partial settings update: absent fields keep their current value. `captcha: null` disables
CAPTCHA; an object enables or replaces it.

oneOf.description: Absent fields stay unchanged. The system tenant refuses any policy but `disabled` (422).

Absent rules stay unchanged; `null` disables a rule. Claim names that collide with
protocol or standard claims are refused (422).
Absent fields stay unchanged. The system tenant refuses any policy but `disabled` (422).

email_otp.description: Turning it on needs SMTP (tenant SMTP settings or the installation SMTP).

magic_link.description: Turning it on needs SMTP (tenant SMTP settings or the installation SMTP).

signing_algs.description:
The complete list of enabled algorithms (RS256 is always kept). Disabling an algorithm
that a client uses for its ID tokens is refused with 409.

discovery_url.description: The OpenID Provider configuration document of [`Self::issuer`].

issuer.description:
The tenant's canonical issuer, computed by the server: `{scheme}://{host}` for a custom
host, the public URL for `default`, else `{public_url}/t/{slug}`.

ThemeColorsDto.description: Theme colours (`#rgb`, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`); absent or `null` = theme default.

ThemeTokensDto.description: Design tokens of a branding scope.

oneOf.description: Colours for `prefers-color-scheme: dark`; `null` = derived from the light set.

font_family.description: System font stack (letters, digits, spaces, commas, hyphens, quotes; 1-200 characters).

ThemeWarningDto.description: A contrast between 3:1 and 4.5:1 (accepted, shown to the admin).

TokenClaimMapping.description:
How a user's roles and permissions are mapped into tokens. `null` disables a mapping.
Default: `roles` in every token gated by scope `roles`; `permissions` in the access token
only, not gated.

TokenClaimMappingPatch.description: Partial claim mapping update: an absent field keeps the current rule, `null` disables it.

claim.description: The claim name; protocol and standard claims (`sub`, `email`, ...) are refused.

scope.description: A single scope that must be granted for the claim to appear; `null` = always.

tokens.description: The tokens the claim goes into.

TokenFormat.description: Format of the access tokens issued to a client.

TokenTarget.description: Where a mapped claim is emitted.

UpdateClient.description:
Body of `PATCH …/clients/{client_id}`. Client type, application type and auth method are
fixed at creation. `jwks: null` clears the JWK Set.

oneOf.description: `null` falls back to the tenant's policy.
Must stay `off` in the system tenant.

UpdateConnection.description:
Body of `PATCH …/connections/{id}`: absent fields stay unchanged. The slug is immutable and
`config` must keep the kind; the secret is changed with `PUT …/secret`.

accept_email_trust_risk.description: Required when turning on email trust for a Microsoft connection.

oneOf.description: The complete new configuration (same kind).

UpdateTenant.description:
Body of `PATCH /tenants/{slug}`. Absent fields stay unchanged; `host: null` clears the host.
`settings` is merged with the current settings field by field.

UpdateUser.description:
Body of `PATCH …/users/{user_id}`. `username: null` clears the username; `status: blocked`
blocks sign-in.

UserAttributes.description:
A user's attribute values. Keys without a current definition (left by a deleted definition)
are kept and shown.

next_cursor.description: Present if and only if more items follow.

UserStatus.description: Whether a user may sign in.

UserView.description: A user. Password data is never returned.

WebhookDeliveryDto.description: One delivery of an event to an endpoint. The payload (ids only) is not returned.

error_class.description:
Error class of the last failed attempt (`status_5xx`, `status_4xx`, `status_429`,
`redirect`, `timeout`, `network`, `blocked`, `gone`, `internal`); never a response body.

id.description: Also the `webhook-id` header of every attempt.

last_http_status.description: HTTP status of the last attempt; `null` if none was received.

next_attempt_at.description: When the next attempt is due (pending deliveries only).

WebhookDeliveryList.description: One page of deliveries, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Present if and only if more items follow.

WebhookEndpointDto.description: A webhook endpoint. The signing secret is write-only.

disabled_reason.description:
Why the system disabled the endpoint (`gone` after an HTTP 410); `null` otherwise.
Re-enabling clears it.

previous_secret_expires_at.description: End of the rotation window during which the previous secret still signs; `null` if none.

secret_configured.description: Always `true`: a secret is stored (sealed); it cannot be read back.

WebhookEndpointPatch.description:
Body of `PATCH /tenants/{slug}/webhooks/{id}`. Absent fields stay unchanged; `events`
replaces the whole set.

WebhookEndpointWithSecret.description: An endpoint with its signing secret: returned by create and secret rotation only.

secret.description: The Standard Webhooks signing secret (`whsec_…`). Shown once; store it now.

WebhookEventType.description: A webhook event type. `test` is only sent by the test action and cannot be subscribed to.

scopes.admin:read: Read everything: tenants and their settings, clients, users and their credentials, sessions, the audit log, email templates and SMTP settings
scopes.admin:write: Full administration: read and write everything (tenants and their settings, clients, users and their credentials, sessions, email templates, SMTP settings and test sends)

oauth2.description: Access tokens of the system tenant (client_credentials grant of a system-tenant client). Each operation lists the admin scopes that grant it.
